cards.title: Scoring and guessing: quick review
cards.body: Right $6$, blank $1.5$, wrong $0$. A guess among $n$ choices is worth $\frac{6}{n}$ on average: guess only after ruling out at least $2$ choices. Stuck for $2$ minutes with no plan? Mark it, skip it, come back.

cards.title: Habits: quick review
cards.body: Read the question twice and draw it. Count carefully: $n$ posts make $n - 1$ gaps, and $a$ to $b$ with both ends has $b - a + 1$ numbers. Work backwards by undoing the last step first. Test the choices starting with (C). Estimate, then rule out by size, last digit, and odd or even.

cards.title: How the check works
cards.body: First a short warm-up. Then the check: $8$ AMC-style problems with choices, easiest first, no hints. You need all $8$ right (100%) to pass. If you miss one, you'll see the solutions and which skills to review, and the next try gives you new problems.

prompts: Which habit from this unit will you use first on your next test?
Which skill will you keep practising in the daily review?
